frozen_after: Two identical 55-second full-atlas executions for preregistered H13 rank 319 timed out with no result file.

method.denominator: Certify D(s)>0 on entire source segment exactly.
method.target: For the frozen single left boundary, certify the target numerator is strictly increasing, has negative sign at L and positive sign at the witness, and isolate the unique root by exact rational bisection.
method.non_target_conditions: Certify every required non-target KKT numerator strictly positive on the complete source segment using exact polynomial positivity certificates.
method.independent_regression: At exact rational probes, compare every symbolic numerator identity to direct matrix evaluation; require zero mismatches, strict positivity inside the predicted component, and the frozen target nonpositive outside.
method.classification: Resolved only if the target has the prescribed unique left crossing and every other KKT condition certifies positive across the full source segment.

adjudication.support: All exact sufficient conditions pass and direct rational regression has zero discrepancies.
adjudication.refute_or_failed: Any exact contradiction, wrong target sign/monotonicity, non-target nonpositivity, or direct symbolic/matrix mismatch.
adjudication.inconclusive: A required exact positivity certificate cannot be completed without a mathematical contradiction.

no_posthoc_changes: No rank, witness, source segment, target boundary, support, tolerance, or prediction may be changed after diagnostic outcomes are inspected.

scope.meaning: This protocol can mathematically resolve the frozen H13 prediction for repeated-timeout rank 319, but does not retroactively make the original full-atlas rank complete.
